	// value size

+package main
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/rosedblabs/rosedb/v2"
+)
+
+func main() {
+	// Remove any existing test database
+	os.RemoveAll("/tmp/rosedb-test")
+
+	// Open database
+	options := rosedb.DefaultOptions
+	options.DirPath = "/tmp/rosedb-test"
+	db, err := rosedb.Open(options)
+	if err != nil {
+		panic(err)
+	}
+	defer db.Close()
+
+	// Put some records with short TTL
+	err = db.PutWithTTL([]byte("key1"), []byte("value1"), time.Second)
+	if err != nil {
+		panic(err)
+	}
+
+	err = db.PutWithTTL([]byte("key2"), []byte("value2"), time.Second)
+	if err != nil {
+		panic(err)
+	}
+
+	// Put a record without TTL
+	err = db.Put([]byte("key3"), []byte("value3"))
+	if err != nil {
+		panic(err)
+	}
+
+	// Wait for TTL to expire
+	time.Sleep(2 * time.Second)
+
+	// Create iterator and iterate through all records
+	iter := db.NewIterator(rosedb.DefaultIteratorOptions)
+	defer iter.Close()
+
+	fmt.Println("Records before iteration:")
+	for iter.Rewind(); iter.Valid(); iter.Next() {
+		item := iter.Item()
+		fmt.Printf("Key: %s, Value: %s\n", item.Key, item.Value)
+	}
+
+	fmt.Println("\nRecords after iteration:")
+
+	// Try to get the expired records
+	for i := 1; i <= 3; i++ {
+		key := fmt.Sprintf("key%d", i)
+		value, err := db.Get([]byte(key))
+		if err != nil {
+			fmt.Printf("Key: %s, Error: %v\n", key, err)
+		} else {
+			fmt.Printf("Key: %s, Value: %s\n", key, value)
+		}
+	}
+}
